front.transcription:
MEDUSA'S EFFECTS
"We're startin' to learn more about the MEDUSA plague; it's highly contagious, and every new strain they cook up is gonna get worse.
The lab says it causes 'mild paralysis of several autonomous functions,' so breathing, muscle coordination, and the like are affected. The treatment we have is only really good at slowin' the spread of it, so try to avoid exposure. I need my agents to stay healthy out there."
Right Now
Open the following doors:
H 29 J 40
Then add the Symptom and Infection cards to the reserve.
